problem:
Consider the linear transformation $T$ with matrix representation $T,$ given by

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 0 \\ 1 & 2\end{aligned}].
$$

What are the coordinates of the point ${A}^{′}$, the image of $A(-1,1)$ under the action of $T?$
worked_solution:
To find the image of $A$ under the action of $T$, we first create a column-vector $x$ containing the coordinates of $A:$

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 1\end{aligned}].
$$

Now, we compute the image of $x$ under the action of $T$ by calculating the matrix product $Tx:$

$$
\begin{aligned}Tx & =[\begin{aligned}-2 & 0 \\ 1 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

The result, $Tx,$ contains the coordinates of ${A}^{′}.$ Therefore, ${A}^{′}(2,1).$
